legend-san-bernardino-pass-road.slogan: San Bernardino Pass Road – a named road, mapped from its own anchor points
legend-san-bernardino-pass-road.story: curated scenic road. high alpine, historic route, stone villages. From Thusis it runs 44 km to Mesocco; allow about 48 min of riding. The highest point is about 2,100 m. San Bernardino Pass is open in summer only - check it is open before you set off. The line favours views over speed.
